sanity.name: rl-last16, ctrl sae rows, v3_ctrl vs the 131k rows of v1raw

sanity.name: old primary v1 realact mean cos, 0.5076
sanity.provenance: SMOKES.md 2026-09-15, rows 0-7 of 2026-09-16_v1. NOT THE SAME STATISTIC as a raw set's `cos`: the stored 0.5076 is cos(h, unit(act - stats_mu)) -- target centred, scorer raw, Celeste's asymmetry -- and on a `storage: raw` set `score` produces cos (neither side centred) and cos_centred (both), never that third column. SMOKES.md 2026-09-21 records this as plan gate 2 being unevaluable rather than failed. Printed for the record with no verdict; delete the line or restate the gate against cos_centred once that is decided. The BARE selector is deliberate: on a set with two old-primary arms this resolves `absent` (matched 2 of the sources), which is right -- the 0.5076 belongs to neither arm.
